chemistry-killer-03.title: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic
chemistry-killer-03.topic: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic
chemistry-killer-03.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-03.material: An sa 14 g na nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$) da 4 g na hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) a cikin kwantena suka amsa gaba ɗaya suka samar da ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Amsawar ita ce $\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, nauyin atom H=1, N=14, kuma amsawar tana ci gaba har sai ɗaya daga cikin masu amsawa ya ƙare. Wane haɗi ne ya nuna daidai da jeri taron $\mathrm{NH_3}$ da aka samu (g) da girman duk iskar gas a kwantena bayan amsawa da aka mayar zuwa yanayin ma'auni (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L)?
chemistry-killer-03.thinking.0: Kiyayewar mass, ƙayyadadden rabon abubuwa, exothermic da endothermic
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: An sa 14 g na nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$) da 4 g na hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) a cikin kwantena suka amsa gaba ɗaya suka samar da ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Amsawar ita ce $\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, nauyin atom H=1, N=14, kuma amsawar tana ci gaba har sai ɗaya daga cikin masu amsawa ya ƙare. Wane haɗi ne ya nuna daidai da jeri taron $\mathrm{NH_3}$ da aka samu (g) da girman duk iskar gas a kwantena bayan amsawa da aka mayar zuwa yanayin ma'auni (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L)?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: Mole. $\mathrm{N_2}$ 14 g ÷ 28 g/mol = 0.5 mol, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 4 g ÷ 2 g/mol = 2 mol.
Mataki na 2: Kwatanta ƙimar da aka raba da ƙididdigar. $\mathrm{N_2}$: 0.5/1 = 0.5, $\mathrm{H_2}$: 2/3 ≈ 0.67. $\mathrm{N_2}$ mai ƙaramar ƙima shi ne limiting reactant.
Mataki na 3: Idan duk 0.5 mol na $\mathrm{N_2}$ ya amsa, ana amfani da 1.5 mol na $\mathrm{H_2}$ kuma ana samar da 1.0 mol na $\mathrm{NH_3}$. Taro = 1.0 × 17 = 17 g. $\mathrm{H_2}$ da ya rage = 2 − 1.5 = 0.5 mol.
Mataki na 4: Jimillar mole na gas bayan amsawa = 1.0 + 0.5 = 1.5 mol → girma a STP = 1.5 × 22.4 = 33.6 L.
Amsa: 17 g, 33.6 L (c). (Kuskure: 22.4 L ƙima ce ba tare da H2 da ya rage ba, 34 g ana samun ta ta rikita mole na N2 da H2 da ninka mole na NH3 da ƙididdiga 2, 8.5 g ƙima ce ta kuskuren rabon N2 : NH3 = 1 : 1)
